about: Popular South African cars and bakkies: fuel tank capacity (litres) and the manufacturer's claimed combined consumption (L/100 km). Researched October 2026 from SA manufacturer spec sheets, cars.co.za, AutoTrader SA, CAR and TopAuto; each entry lists its source. Suggestions only: owners can always change the tank size.
